newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Fed injected reserves to the banking system Wednesday through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements, a New York Fed spokeswoman confirmed.
The operation was expected due to a large add need on the final day of the two-week maintenance period.
Analysts said the reserve addition did not signal a monetary policy change. The FOMC is meeting today to determine the future course of interest rates. It is widely expected to leave rates unchanged.
Fed funds were trading at 5-13/16 percent at the time of the Fed's operation, above the 5-1/2 percent target.
